items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Buster Smith, yes we call him Prof... Buster Smith was a pretty good musician? Right. Yes, he was. But more of a lead than a soloist? Well, I think so. In fact, he had gone when I got there... But when Prof left, Buster, there was nobody to take it.

ctx.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Buster Smith, yes we call him Prof... he left Basie... That's the way it was when I came there... But when Prof left, Buster, there was nobody to take it.

ctx.x: Because my sister had just had a little baby girl. Her name is Jackie, she's in New York now. And I was so crazy about this, my little niece that I called the first number I made for Basie 'Baby Girl', for Jackie. And it was pretty good. A pretty good number.
